_comment: The in-app Help & guides catalogue: the ONE place guide metadata lives. The server (Services/GuideCatalog.cs) lists and authorises from it; the client bundle (Client/guides/guides.ts) imports it for the offline links in the tester app.

To publish a new version of a guide: 1) replace the PDF in this folder under the SAME file name; 2) bump its version and date below; 3) run `npm run build:prod` in src/Autorep.Web, since the client bundle embeds this file; 4) commit the PDF and this file, plus wwwroot/sw.js if the build re-stamped it.

Devices pick the new copy up by themselves: /guides/* is served with an ETag of the file's hash and the service worker revalidates on every open while online, replacing its offline copy. Links carry ?v=<hash> as well, so no browser cache can hold the old one.
A NEW guide needs a new entry here (file names lowercase, digits and hyphens only). roles = who sees it and who may download it; a guide an account can't see answers 403.
The PDFs are deliberately outside wwwroot: everything under wwwroot is served anonymously by UseStaticFiles, and the admin guides must need a sign-in.
